title: Im Stillen Winkel, Krefeld
description:
Tasteful, furnished penthouse apartment with 4 rooms and a balcony

This apartment is a totally renovated house, finished in December 2022. This is a very special apartment in Forstwald, Krefeld. On a total of 130 square meters, you live in a luxurious and fully furnished apartment, right on the outskirts of Dusseldorf.

The apartment is located on the first and second floor and is divided into a large living - and dining area, two bedrooms, a separate kitchen, and a large south facing terrace.

Already when entering the apartment the large & bright entrance area impresses. A separate room as walk-in cabinet offers enough space to store your clothes.

At the end of the hallway you enter into the spacious living - and dining area, which is also very bright due to its floor-to-ceiling windows and doors. There, among other things, you find a cozy living landscape with home theater, and - on the opposite side - a large dining table, which offers enough space for at least six people.

If you open the door from the living room, you get to the terrace. Here you have enough space to barbecue with friends in the summer or simply enjoy the evening after work.

The large bedroom offers quiet nights and a beautiful view into the garden as well as a high-quality box spring bed. Other bedroom is at your disposal,  if you are currently working in home office - you also have an extra writing desk in this bedroom at your disposition.

The apartment is equipped with a large wellness bathroom. The entire flat has a high value parket flooring with an underfloor heating system.

The location is an ideal starting point to get to Dusseldorf. Located in a quiet area you find both green surroundings but also supermarkets, restaurants and other shops in walking distance. Here you can move in, unpack your suitcase and feel right at home!

title: Pastoriusstraße, Krefeld
description:
Genießen Sie das Leben in dieser ruhig gelegenen und dennoch zentralen Unterkunft, perfekt für bis zu 2 Personen. Die Wohnung bietet ein komfortables Schlafzimmer mit Doppelbett sowie ein Durchgangszimmer mit einem Sofa. Die Lage überzeugt mit ihrer Nähe zur Burg Linn und dem Naherholungsgebiet Greiffenhorstpark. Dank der guten Anbindung erreichen Sie die Düsseldorfer Messe und Arena in nur 20 Autominuten, Düsseldorf Zentrum 30 Autominuten. Auch Duisburg (25 Autominuten) und Köln (45 Autominuten) sind bequem erreichbar. ÖPNV ist in unmittelbarer Nähe. Supermärkte und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten sind fußläufig erreichbar. Die Wohnung ist voll ausgestattet: Waschmaschine + Trockner, Bettwäsche, Handtücher, Fön, Backofen, Gasherd, Mikrowelle, WLAN und TV (2 Stück Wohnzimmer und im Durchgangszimmer) stehen Ihnen zur Verfügung. Im Keller befindet sich die Waschküche, wo die Wäsche zum Trocknen aufgehängt werden kann.
Kostenfreie Parkplätze sind direkt an der Straße vorhanden.

.

.

.
- Bath & Laundry: Spacious bathroom with shower and whirlpool. A private washing machine and dryer are available in the apartment..
.

.
- Building & Access: Enjoy full temporal flexibility during check-in thanks to modern smart locks (code access)..
.
.
# About the Surroundings.
.
Your strategic location: Between Silk and Velvet City history, modern architecture, and direct proximity to the metropolis of Düsseldorf..
.

# Location & Connectivity.
.
- Public Transport: The tram station is reachable in only about 6 minutes on foot (500 m)..
.
- Trade Fair & Airport: Messe Düsseldorf and DUS Airport are only about 20 km away (approx. 20-25 min by car)..
.
- Krefeld Center: The main station and city center can be reached in about 5 minutes by car or train (2 km)..
.
- Nature & Sports: Elfrather See and the City Forest are in the immediate vicinity..
.
.
# Your Fast Path to Destinations:.
.
- Target: Krefeld Zoo / Grotenburg | Transport: Walk / Bike | Duration: approx. 12 / 4 min..
.
- Target: Messe Düsseldorf | Transport: Car | Duration: approx. 22 minutes.
.
- Target: Krefeld Center / Shopping | Transport: Train / Car | Duration: approx. 8 minutes.
.
- Target: Elfrather See | Transport: Car | Duration: approx. 8 minutes.
.
.
# Shopping & Local Supplies.
.
Everything for daily needs is within walking distance: several supermarkets (REWE, Netto), bakeries, and cafes can be reached within 5 to 10 minutes on foot. The central city center also offers everything for an extensive shopping trip..
.
.
# Gastronomy & Going Out.
.
Krefeld offers a diverse gastronomy. Whether the traditional brewery "Wienges" in the city or fine dining at the Krefeld Stadtwald – there is something for every taste..
.
.
# Leisure & Recreation.
.
Krefeld is known for its parks and architecture:.
.
- Krefeld Zoo: An absolute highlight with the famous rainforest house, only a few minutes away..
.
- Stadtwald: One of Germany's most beautiful parks with a large pond and pedal boat rental..
.
- Burg Linn: A historical moated castle with an extensive park and museum..
.
.
# Host's Insider Tips.
.
- Tip 1 (Architecture): Visit the Haus Lange and Haus Esters by Mies van der Rohe. World-famous modern architecture right in Krefeld..
.
- Tip 2 (Culinary): The Stadtwaldhaus offers one of the most beautiful beer gardens in the region – ideal for a relaxed evening under old chestnut trees..
.
- Tip 3 (Historical): The Krefeld horse racing track (Galopprennbahn) is a beautiful destination even on non-race days with its Art Nouveau architecture..
.
- Tip 4 (Nature): A walk through the Hülser Bruch to the observation tower on the Hülser Berg offers a great view over the Lower Rhine..
.
- Tip 5 (Maritime): The Rhine promenade in Krefeld-Uerdingen invites you to linger by the water while the large ships pass by..
.
.
# Important Notes on Accommodation & Location.
.
The apartment is located on the 2nd floor (rooftop studio) and is only accessible via the staircase (no elevator)..
.
Please note the open layout: in addition to the two private bedrooms, there are further beds in the gallery walk-through area and in the living room, highlighting the generous loft character..
.
---.
